watch.summary: The streamer and an enemy player engage in a prolonged, painfully inaccurate gunfight in Valorant before the streamer finally secures a low-skill kill.

beats.what: Text overlay declares 'The WORST Players in Valorant meet' as the streamer turns the corner.
Both players spray an entire magazine at each other from point-blank range and miss almost every bullet.
The streamer finally lands the killing shot after a prolonged, clumsy duel.
The streamer bursts out laughing at how terrible both of them played.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: Oh my god that was the worst
watch.why: The comedy stems from the absurd lack of skill displayed by both players in a high-stakes shooter, making the long Whiff-fest genuinely funny. The streamer's immediate self-aware laughter enhances the joke without needing deeper game knowledge.
